about_the_game:
Embark on the adventure of Frank, a young man who, tired of his life, decides to travel to Europe in search of a better future. But his journey takes an unexpected turn when his ship is shipwrecked,

leaving him stranded on a mysterious island full of dangers.

In this unknown territory, strange humanoid Capybaras rule firmly. To survive, Frank must explore, face challenges and find a way to escape.

Will he be able to overcome the dangers of the island and reach his destiny?

Find out and help Frank on this epic adventure!

Explore and discover.

Explore the island as you progress through the story and discover ancient ruins, strange forests, beaches and different towns. The more you explore, the more resources you will get!

Each place has its own story and is waiting for you!

Combat

Face the dangerous Capybara sect that has taken over the island.

You will have Shields and various swords that you can buy in shops on the island, there are also weapons that you can collect from the world and win in missions.

Chests

Chests are hidden all over the island, in them you can find healing items, bombs, money and junk.

They will be a great help for Frank!!

Collectibles.

On the island you will find two types of collectibles hidden and scattered throughout the stages!

*Collect all the collectible mates. (Frank loves drinking mates, so he will want to take all the mates from the island.)

*Collect all the lost cats. (Frank is a cat lover, so he will want to rescue all the lost cats he finds.)

Shrines

Explore and complete the different Shrines you'll find on the island.

In them you can collect coins and use them to buy an extra heart to increase your life.

Be careful! In this strange dimension, there will be many traps that will make it difficult for you to advance.

Complete the island's mini games!

The island is full of mini challenges that, when completed, will unlock valuable chests.

Explore dangerous dungeons!

The Capybara cultists have summoned strange beings into the dungeons, survive them and discover their secrets as you progress through the story.
